page.layout: One page of text, centred: a decorative woodcut border at the top, then a title block (IN / ANTI-BARBARUM / Clarissimi eximiique Viri, / SIXTINI AMAMA), then a verse poem with a large decorative initial, ending with the signature DANIEL HEINSIUS. No margin notes, no running head, no page number.

l.i: Mproba ma jorumqua nata est tempore primum., Babaries, nostro tempore pulsa fuit. Gracia nata fuit: -Latiæ crevere Camœnæ:
Quisque sua Musas fovit & auxit ope.
Nec summi procerum, nec Regum prona voluntas

main_text.l: Defuit, ex illis pars quoque nostra fuit.

l.i: Orta dies fuerat: sed qua, vix orta, repente
Has tenebras inter dubiaque crepuscula lucis,
Altera fax oritur, nec prius orta dies.
Sol oritur, Sixtine, tuus, quo vindice rursus
Nec tibi Phœbeam satis est decerpere laurum,
Quam Latium, vel quam Gracia docta colit:
Nobilior nulli lecta corona tua est.
Laurum alii sibi quisque gerant, tibi palma parata
est. Hanc Oriens soli servat, amice, tibi.

page.notes: The large initial "E" is a decorative woodcut. Text is in italic with roman names. The line "Mproba ma" with italic "M" is a decorative initial/printing irregularity; readings of "Mproba ma jorumqua" are doubtful, as are "Gracia nata fuit: -Latiæ" (dash as printed). The watermark "Digitized by Google" at the lower right is omitted.
